cd /workspace/submission && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import pathlib, re

discovery = pathlib.Path('discovery.py').read_text()
calibration = pathlib.Path('calibration.py').read_text()
backuptree = pathlib.Path('backuptree.py').read_text()
banks = pathlib.Path('banks.py').read_text()

header_gen = '''"""Packet-segment extraction, exact distance, clustering and range form.

This is the repaired offline discovery half of the pipeline: high-activation
runs become fragments, fragments are clustered per class and length with the
contract's anchored distance, and every cluster is expressed as one inclusive
generalized interval per coordinate.  Every comparison the contract declares
exact (activation threshold, eps neighbourhood, sigma bounds) is evaluated with
integer arithmetic; floating point only pre-filters, and its borderline band is
resolved exactly, so eps and sigma equality are honoured without tolerance.
"""
'''
body = discovery[discovery.index('import numpy as np'):]

pathlib.Path('offline_discovery/rule_generate.py').write_text(header_gen + body)

header_remove = '''"""Coverage, filtering, scoring and bank-entry census for discovered rules.

The validation coverage of every generalized interval is computed with one
bitmask sweep per validation row per pattern length, scores stay exact
Fractions, the shared priority orders kept clusters by decreasing exact score
then increasing cluster id, and the exact-match census counts distinct keys of
the retained Cartesian boxes with the documented capacity clipping.
"""
'''
body = calibration[calibration.index('from fractions import Fraction'):]
pathlib.Path('offline_discovery/rule_remove.py').write_text(header_remove + body)

header_rf = '''"""CPU backup tree: the pinned scikit-learn decision-tree path.

The certificate is the fitted tree itself: leaves are [class] and branches are
[feature_index, 2*threshold, left_index, right_index] in native node order, so
replay and certificate share one exact integer decision rule.  Feature
truncation and 1514 right-padding match the training rows exactly.
"""
'''
body = backuptree[backuptree.index('import numpy as np'):]
pathlib.Path('online_matching/train_rf.py').write_text(header_rf + body)

header_p4 = '''"""Resident release banks and online segment tables.

Both bank flavours store the same generalized intervals; an exact bank's
Cartesian key set is exactly pointwise containment, so a window is a table key
precisely when it lies inside every inclusive interval of a kept cluster.
Tables are indexed by the tightest coordinate and scanned in priority order, so
the first hit is the highest-priority matching cluster.
"""
'''
body = banks[banks.index('import numpy as np'):]
pathlib.Path('online_matching/match_p4.py').write_text(header_p4 + body)

for name in ('discovery.py', 'calibration.py', 'backuptree.py', 'banks.py'):
    pathlib.Path(name).unlink()

pipeline = pathlib.Path('pipeline.py').read_text()
pipeline = pipeline.replace("from discovery import derive_fragments, build_clusters",
                            "from offline_discovery.rule_generate import derive_fragments\n"
                            "from offline_discovery.rule_generate import build_clusters")
pipeline = pipeline.replace("from calibration import RowIndex, batch_hits, cluster_score, priority_order\n"
                            "from calibration import exact_entry_count",
                            "from offline_discovery.rule_remove import RowIndex, batch_hits\n"
                            "from offline_discovery.rule_remove import cluster_score, priority_order\n"
                            "from offline_discovery.rule_remove import exact_entry_count")
pipeline = pipeline.replace("from backuptree import BackupTree",
                            "from online_matching.train_rf import BackupTree")
pipeline = pipeline.replace("from banks import BankTable",
                            "from online_matching.match_p4 import BankTable")
pathlib.Path('pipeline.py').write_text(pipeline)
print(open('pipeline.py').read()[:1400])
PYEOF
